name: One&Only Cape Town
positioning: Resort in Cape Town's Victoria & Alfred Waterfront, overlooking the marina with panoramic views of Table Mountain, with a spa on its own little island
best_for: Travelers who want a Waterfront base with Table Mountain views
Spa lovers who want hydrotherapy facilities and a garden yoga pavilion
Families who want a kids' club with supervised visits to the Two Oceans Aquarium

facts.text: The resort is in Cape Town's Victoria & Alfred Waterfront.
The hotel is next door to the Two Oceans Aquarium.
In the Marina Rise rooms, the bathroom can be separated from the bedroom by sliding panels.
The spa has private wet areas and a yoga pavilion in the garden.
The gym offers personal trainers, boxing, bootcamp, yoga and mat-based pilates.
The kids' club offers arts and crafts, baking and cooking classes, outdoor games and supervised visits to the Two Oceans Aquarium.
The resort partners with the neighbouring Two Oceans Aquarium Foundation on a baby sea-turtle rehabilitation programme.
The resort's team can arrange airport transfers using a fleet of luxury cars.
Ochre focuses on South African cuisine and local ingredients.
The Vista Bar and Lounge serves cocktails, high tea and light meals.

highlights.text: The spa is situated on its own little island.
The resort has panoramic views of Table Mountain.
The spa's his-and-hers hydrotherapy facilities each have a vitality pool, aroma-steam room, sauna, ice fountain and experience showers.
The island suites are steps from the spa and the free-form infinity pool.
Even the entry-level rooms have an egg-shaped bath, rain shower and dual marble vanities.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes limited beach access due to the marina location.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the ultra-luxury positioning.
Check-in is at 2pm and check-out is at 11am.
